story_description: Implement all settings category views and their entry points.
task_description: Users need to configure Git integration including auto-run, commit style, co-author settings, and worktree management.
atom_description: Users need to configure Git integration including auto-run, commit style, co-author settings, and worktree management.
problem_statement: Users need to configure Git integration including auto-run, commit style, co-author settings, and worktree management.
scope_in: Auto-run git commands toggle; commit style picker; co-author toggle; auto-stash toggle; worktree settings
Implement GitSettingsView.swift according to the problem statement and functional requirements.
scope_out: Actual git command execution; worktree management
Exclude work assigned to other atoms or features in this epic.
assumptions: Blaze app builds successfully with `swift build` before work begins
@AppStorage is the persistence mechanism for user preferences
Actor-based stores (HookStore pattern) are the standard for data persistence
constraints: Some settings only apply to git repos
Must not block main UI thread
Must use glass styling via DSGlass for all settings panels
Must persist state across app restarts
All user-facing strings must be localizable (use String constants)
No third-party dependencies without explicit approval
functional_requirements: Auto-run git writes toggle (with security warning)
nonfunctional_requirements: Settings apply to new git operations
Must not block the main UI thread.
api_contracts: Primary API surface is the GitSettingsView.swift type and its public members.
Public APIs match Swift naming conventions and are documented in code comments.
event_contracts: Event contracts are defined through telemetry events for this atom.
No additional runtime event protocol is introduced.
ui_states: Not a git repo: Settings disabled
ui_copy: Labels: "Auto-run Git Commands", "Commit Style", "Include Co-Author", "Auto-Stash", "Worktree per Task"
Warning: "Auto-run may execute git commands without confirmation"
edge_cases: Not a git repo - disable git settings
Git not installed - show install prompt
failure_modes: Git not found - settings disabled with message
If persistence fails, log an error and keep the previous value.
